_comment: Phase 7 (docs/experiment/spec/07_versioning_and_replay.md) — which contracts/<kind>/vN directory is CURRENTLY LIVE, per kind, independently. Read by services/decision_service/manifest.py on every manifest build (decision_service's own startup, and any process that re-reads it) so 'deploying' a new contract version is a data-only change here plus a decision_service restart (docker compose restart decision_service) -- no image rebuild, matching the bind-mount pattern already established for services/action_worker (F34) and services/opa. NEVER edited by decision_service itself -- only by migrations/*/deploy.py scripts, under an operator's control, exactly like a real contract redeploy.
